Song.name: Zhao Zhen
Song.title: Emperor Renzong
Song.note: Empress Dowager Liu ruled as regent until 1033.

Liao.name: Yelü Longxu
Liao.title: Emperor Shengzong of Liao
Liao.note: His mother Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo ruled as regent until 1009.
Liao.note_zh: 其母萧太后（萧绰）摄政至1009年。

Xixia.name: Li Yiyin
Xixia.title: Military Governor of Dingnan
Xixia.note: Changed his name to Li Yixing to avoid a Song taboo.

Xixia.name: Li Jipeng
Xixia.title: Military Governor of Dingnan
Xixia.note: Handed his lands to the Song in 982.

Xixia.name: Li Jiqian
Xixia.title: Emperor Taizu of Xia (posthumous)
Xixia.note: Led the Tangut revolt against the Song.

Xixia.name: Li Yuanhao
Xixia.title: Emperor Jingzong of Xia
Xixia.note: Declared himself emperor of Great Xia in 1038.

Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).name: Ichijō
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).title: Emperor Ichijō
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note: Fujiwara no Michinaga dominated the court.

Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).name: Shirakawa
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).title: Emperor Shirakawa
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note: After abdicating in 1087 he kept power as retired emperor (insei).
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note_zh: 1087年让位后以上皇身份继续执政（院政）。

Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).name: Ngô Xương Văn
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).title: King of Nam Tấn
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note: After his death the country split among twelve warlords until 968.
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note_zh: 他死后十二使君割据，直到968年。

Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).name: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).title: Đinh Tiên Hoàng
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note: Reunited the country and named it Đại Cồ Việt.
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note_zh: 统一全境，定国号为大瞿越。

Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).name: Lý Công Uẩn
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).title: Lý Thái Tổ
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note: Moved the capital to Thăng Long (Hanoi) in 1010.

Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).name: Lý Nhật Tôn
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).title: Lý Thánh Tông
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note: Renamed the country Đại Việt in 1054.

Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).name: Lý Càn Đức
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).title: Lý Nhân Tông
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note: His general Lý Thường Kiệt fought the Song war of 1075-1077.
Jiaozhi (Đại Cồ Việt).note_zh: 其将李常杰与宋朝交战（1075—1077年）。

Dali.name: Gao Shengtai
Dali.title: Ruler of Dazhong
Dali.note: The Gao minister family briefly took the throne.

southern-tang-conquered.note: A pontoon bridge across the Yangtze at Caishi let the Song army cross.
southern-tang-conquered.note_zh: 宋军在采石架设长江浮桥，大军得以渡江。

gaoliang.note: Taizong was wounded and escaped on a donkey cart, as later accounts tell it.
gaoliang.note_zh: 据后世记载，宋太宗中箭负伤，乘驴车逃走。

haoshuichuan.note: Han Qi planned the campaign; Ren Fu led the army into the ambush.
haoshuichuan.note_zh: 韩琦主持此役，任福率军中伏。
haoshuichuan.losses: Ren Fu and many officers killed

first-siege-kaifeng.note: The city held, but Song paid a huge ransom and promised three frontier towns.
first-siege-kaifeng.note_zh: 开封守住了，但宋朝支付了巨额赔款并答应割让三镇。

routes.name: Song fleet down the Yangtze
routes.summary: Cao Bin's army sailed down the Yangtze from Jingnan, crossed at Caishi on a pontoon bridge and besieged Jinling.
routes.summary_zh: 曹彬率军自荆南顺江东下，从采石浮桥渡江，围攻金陵。

routes.name: Taizong marches on Youzhou
routes.summary: After taking Taiyuan, Taizong pushed east and north to Youzhou and was routed at the Gaoliang River.
routes.summary_zh: 攻下太原后，宋太宗挥师东进北上，直抵幽州，在高梁河大败。

routes.name: Liao invasion and the road to Chanyuan
routes.summary: Liao armies drove deep into Hebei to Chanzhou on the Yellow River, where the 1005 peace treaty was made.
routes.summary_zh: 辽军深入河北，直抵黄河边的澶州，双方在此订立澶渊之盟。

routes.name: Xia army to Haoshuichuan
routes.summary: Li Yuanhao marched south from Xingqing and set an ambush in the Haoshuichuan valley.
routes.summary_zh: 李元昊从兴庆府南下，在好水川设下埋伏。

routes.name: Maritime Silk Road
routes.summary: Song ships and foreign merchants sailed from Quanzhou and Guangzhou through the Malacca Strait to Sri Lanka and India.
routes.summary_zh: 宋朝船只和外国商人从泉州、广州出发，经马六甲海峡驶往斯里兰卡和印度。

routes.name: Jurchen campaigns against the Liao
routes.summary: From Ningjiang the Jurchens took Huanglong, then the Liao capitals one by one, and caught the last emperor near Yingzhou.
routes.summary_zh: 女真从宁江州起兵，攻下黄龙府，又依次攻占辽朝各京，最后在应州一带俘获辽帝。

routes.name: Jin eastern army marches on Kaifeng
routes.summary: Wanyan Zongwang's army took Yanjing, swept through Hebei, crossed the Yellow River and besieged Kaifeng.
routes.summary_zh: 完颜宗望率军攻下燕京，横扫河北，渡过黄河，包围开封。

people.name: Fan Kuan
people.known_for: Landscape painter of towering, monumental mountains.
people.known_for_zh: 山水画家，以雄伟高耸的山峰著称。

people.name: Liu Yong
people.known_for: Ci poet who wrote popular slow songs for the city's entertainers.
people.known_for_zh: 词人，大量创作慢词，在市井中广为传唱。
people.line_zh: 衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴。
people.line_en: My clothes grow loose, yet I have no regret; for her I waste away.

people.name: Fan Zhongyan
people.known_for: Reforming official and writer of the essay on Yueyang Tower.
people.known_for_zh: 改革家、文学家，写下《岳阳楼记》。
people.line_zh: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。
people.line_en: Be first to worry about the world's troubles, and last to enjoy its happiness.

people.name: Ouyang Xiu
people.known_for: Leading prose writer and historian of the Song.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋文坛领袖，也是史学家。

works.title: New History of the Five Dynasties

people.line_zh: 醉翁之意不在酒，在乎山水之间也。
people.line_en: The old drunkard's heart is not in the wine, but in the hills and streams.

people.name: Zhou Dunyi
people.known_for: Founder of Neo-Confucian cosmology.
people.known_for_zh: 理学开山之祖。
people.line_zh: 出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖。
people.line_en: It rises from the mud unstained, washed by clear ripples yet not showy.

people.name: Zhang Zai
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian thinker who taught that everything is made of qi.
people.known_for_zh: 理学家，主张万物都由“气”构成。
people.line_zh: 为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平。
people.line_en: To set the mind of heaven and earth, secure the life of the people, carry on lost learning, and open peace for all ages.

people.name: Sima Guang
people.known_for: Wrote the great chronological history 'Comprehensive Mirror' in Luoyang.
people.known_for_zh: 在洛阳编成编年体通史《资治通鉴》。

people.name: Guo Xi
people.known_for: Court landscape painter and theorist.
people.known_for_zh: 宫廷山水画家、画论家。

people.name: Shen Kuo
people.known_for: Polymath whose notebook covers astronomy, maths, geology and technology.
people.known_for_zh: 博学家，笔记涉及天文、数学、地质和技术等。

people.name: Qian Yi
people.known_for: Founder of Chinese paediatrics.
people.known_for_zh: 中医儿科的奠基人。

people.name: Cheng Yi
people.known_for: With his brother Cheng Hao, made 'principle' (li) central to Neo-Confucianism.
people.known_for_zh: 与兄程颢以“理”为核心，奠定理学。

people.name: Su Shi
people.known_for: Great poet, essayist, painter and calligrapher of the Song.
people.known_for_zh: 宋代最杰出的诗人、文学家、书画家之一。
people.line_zh: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。
people.line_en: May we all live long, and share this moon though a thousand miles apart.

people.name: Mi Fu
people.known_for: Calligrapher and painter of misty 'Mi-style' landscapes.
people.known_for_zh: 书画家，所创“米点山水”云烟朦胧。

people.name: Zhang Zeduan
people.known_for: Painted the busy life of Kaifeng in a famous long scroll.
people.known_for_zh: 以长卷描绘开封的繁华市井生活。

works.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival

people.name: Zhao Kuangyin (Emperor Taizu of Song)
people.known_for: Founded the Song dynasty in the Chenqiao mutiny of 960 and curbed military governors' power.
people.known_for_zh: 陈桥兵变建立宋朝，杯酒释兵权，重文抑武。

people.name: Zhao Pu
people.known_for: Chief minister of the early Song who designed its centralizing policies.
people.known_for_zh: 宋初宰相，号称“半部《论语》治天下”。

people.name: Yang Ye
people.known_for: Song frontier general against the Liao, died captive after the 986 campaign; ancestor of the legendary Yang family generals.
people.known_for_zh: 抗辽名将，杨家将故事原型，兵败陈家谷被俘殉国。

people.name: Kou Zhun
people.known_for: Chancellor who persuaded Emperor Zhenzong to lead troops at Chanyuan in 1004, leading to the Chanyuan Treaty with the Liao.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋名相，力主真宗亲征，促成澶渊之盟。

people.name: Xiao Chuo (Empress Dowager Xiao)
people.known_for: Liao regent who personally led the 1004 invasion of Song that ended with the Chanyuan Treaty.
people.known_for_zh: 辽承天太后，摄政掌国，亲征南宋缔结澶渊之盟。

people.name: Yelü Xiuge
people.known_for: Liao general who routed Song armies at the Gaoliang River (979) and Qigou Pass (986).
people.known_for_zh: 辽国名将，高梁河、岐沟关大败宋军。

people.name: Li Yuanhao (Emperor Jingzong of Western Xia)
people.known_for: Founded the Western Xia state in 1038, created the Tangut script and defeated Song armies repeatedly.
people.known_for_zh: 西夏开国皇帝，创制西夏文，屡败宋军。

people.name: Di Qing
people.known_for: Rose from common soldier to Military Commissioner, fighting Western Xia and crushing Nong Zhigao's rebellion in 1053.
people.known_for_zh: 行伍出身的名将，抗击西夏，夜袭昆仑关平侬智高。

people.name: Bao Zheng
people.known_for: Prefect of Kaifeng famed for incorruptibility and impartial justice, later revered as 'Judge Bao'.
people.known_for_zh: 以清廉刚正著称的开封府尹，后世称“包青天”。

people.name: Wang Anshi
people.known_for: Chancellor who launched the sweeping New Policies reforms and was a leading prose writer and poet.
people.known_for_zh: 推行熙宁变法的宰相，唐宋八大家之一。

people.name: Bi Sheng
people.known_for: Invented movable type printing with fired clay characters around 1040, as recorded by Shen Kuo.
people.known_for_zh: 发明泥活字印刷术，见载于沈括《梦溪笔谈》。

people.name: Su Xun
people.known_for: Essayist and father of Su Shi and Su Zhe; one of the Eight Great Prose Masters of Tang and Song.
people.known_for_zh: 三苏之父，唐宋八大家之一，以《六国论》著称。

people.name: Su Zhe
people.known_for: Statesman and essayist, younger brother of Su Shi, one of the Eight Great Prose Masters.
people.known_for_zh: 苏轼之弟，唐宋八大家之一，官至尚书右丞。

people.name: Zeng Gong
people.known_for: Prose master and disciple of Ouyang Xiu, one of the Eight Great Prose Masters of Tang and Song.
people.known_for_zh: 欧阳修门生，唐宋八大家之一，文风平实严谨。

people.name: Huang Tingjian
people.known_for: Poet who founded the Jiangxi school and one of the Four Great Calligraphers of Song.
people.known_for_zh: 江西诗派开山之祖，宋四家书法家之一。

people.name: Cheng Hao
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian philosopher who, with his brother Cheng Yi, developed the learning of principle (li).
people.known_for_zh: 理学奠基人之一，与弟程颐并称“二程”。

people.name: Shao Yong
people.known_for: Cosmological philosopher who built a numerological system of the universe from the Book of Changes.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋理学家，以象数之学推演宇宙。

people.name: Yan Shu
people.known_for: Chancellor and refined ci lyricist who promoted talents such as Fan Zhongyan and Ouyang Xiu.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋宰相、婉约词人，提携范仲淹、欧阳修。

people.name: Qin Guan
people.known_for: Graceful-school ci poet and one of the four scholars of Su Shi's circle.
people.known_for_zh: 苏门四学士之一，婉约派代表词人。

people.name: Zhou Bangyan
people.known_for: Ci poet and musician who headed the imperial music bureau and refined the lyrics' metrical rules.
people.known_for_zh: 提举大晟府的词人，格律派宗师。

people.name: Li Gonglin
people.known_for: Painter famed for baimiao fine-line drawing of horses, figures and Buddhist subjects.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋画家，以白描人物、鞍马著称。

people.name: Zhao Ji (Emperor Huizong of Song)
people.known_for: Emperor, painter and inventor of the slender-gold calligraphy whose reign ended with the Jingkang catastrophe.
people.known_for_zh: 书画皇帝，创瘦金体，靖康之变被俘北去。

people.name: Wang Ximeng
people.known_for: Young court painter who created the monumental blue-green landscape scroll A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains.
people.known_for_zh: 少年宫廷画家，绘青绿山水巨作《千里江山图》。

works.title: A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains

people.name: Wen Tong
people.known_for: Painter famous for ink bamboo, origin of the idiom of having the bamboo complete in one's mind.
people.known_for_zh: 墨竹大家，“胸有成竹”典出于他。

people.name: Cai Xiang
people.known_for: Calligrapher and official who built the Luoyang Bridge at Quanzhou and wrote a treatise on tea.
people.known_for_zh: 宋四家书法家之一，主持修建泉州洛阳桥，著《茶录》。

people.name: Su Song
people.known_for: Statesman-scientist who built a water-driven astronomical clock tower with an escapement mechanism.
people.known_for_zh: 主持制造水运仪象台，并编撰《本草图经》。

works.title: New Design for an Armillary Clock

people.name: Li Jie
people.known_for: Court architect who compiled the Yingzao Fashi, the classic Chinese building standards manual.
people.known_for_zh: 将作监官员，编修建筑典籍《营造法式》。

people.name: Zeng Gongliang
people.known_for: Co-compiled the Wujing Zongyao, a military compendium containing the earliest gunpowder formulas.
people.known_for_zh: 主编《武经总要》，载有最早的火药配方。

people.name: Jia Xian
people.known_for: Mathematician who described the triangle of binomial coefficients and a method for extracting roots.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋数学家，提出“贾宪三角”和增乘开方法。

people.name: Wang Weiyi
people.known_for: Court physician who cast two bronze acupuncture figures and standardized acupuncture points.
people.known_for_zh: 铸造针灸铜人，著《铜人腧穴针灸图经》。

works.title: Illustrated Manual of Acupuncture Points on the Bronze Figure

people.name: Wang Shao
people.known_for: Campaigned in the Xihe region in the 1070s, recovering territory from Tibetan tribes to outflank Western Xia.
people.known_for_zh: 熙河开边，收复河湟，牵制西夏。

people.name: Li Gang
people.known_for: Led the defense of Kaifeng against the Jin in 1126 and briefly served as chancellor.
people.known_for_zh: 靖康年间主持东京保卫战的抗金名臣。

people.name: Fang La
people.known_for: Led a massive peasant uprising in Zhejiang in 1120–1121 against the flower-and-rock levies.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋末起义领袖，反抗花石纲苛政。

people.name: Wanyan Aguda (Emperor Taizu of Jin)
people.known_for: Jurchen chieftain who founded the Jin dynasty in 1115 and destroyed the Liao.
people.known_for_zh: 女真首领，建立金朝，灭辽。

people.name: Cai Jing
people.known_for: Powerful chancellor under Huizong blamed for misrule, also an accomplished calligrapher.
people.known_for_zh: 徽宗朝权相，被列为“六贼”之首，亦善书法。

people.name: Zhang Xian
people.known_for: Early Song ci poet admired for his images of shadows, who helped develop longer lyric forms.
people.known_for_zh: 北宋词人，善写“影”，人称“张三影”。

people.name: Chen Tuan
people.known_for: Daoist sage of Mount Hua whose cosmological diagrams influenced Neo-Confucianism.
people.known_for_zh: 华山道士，所传图学影响宋代理学。

people.name: Li Fang
people.known_for: Led compilation of the great early Song encyclopedias, including the Taiping Yulan.
people.known_for_zh: 主持编纂《太平御览》《太平广记》等宋初类书。

people.name: Lin Bu
people.known_for: Recluse poet of West Lake famed for loving plum blossoms and cranes.
people.known_for_zh: 隐居西湖孤山，“梅妻鹤子”的诗人。

people.name: Mei Yaochen
people.known_for: Poet who pioneered the plain, realistic style of Song shi poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 宋诗开山祖师，提倡平淡诗风。

people.name: Han Xizai
people.known_for: Southern Tang minister whose lavish parties were depicted in 'The Night Revels of Han Xizai'.
people.known_for_zh: 南唐大臣，《韩熙载夜宴图》主人公。

people.name: Li Qingzhao
people.known_for: The greatest woman poet of China; her later ci poems mourn the loss of the north and her husband.
people.known_for_zh: 中国最杰出的女词人，南渡后的词作抒写国破家亡之痛。
people.line_zh: 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。
people.line_en: Searching, seeking, cold and clear, so sad, so bleak, so lonely.

people.name: Han Shizhong
people.known_for: General who trapped the Jin army of Wuzhu at Huangtiandang on the Yangtze in 1130.
people.known_for_zh: 抗金名将，黄天荡困金兀术。

people.name: Liang Hongyu
people.known_for: Wife of Han Shizhong who beat the war drums at Huangtiandang and fought the Jin alongside him.
people.known_for_zh: 韩世忠之妻，黄天荡击鼓助战的巾帼英雄。

people.name: Qin Hui
people.known_for: Chancellor who negotiated the Shaoxing peace with the Jin and engineered Yue Fei's execution.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋宰相，主和议，构陷岳飞。

people.name: Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu)
people.known_for: Jin prince and general who led invasions of the Southern Song and opposed Yue Fei.
people.known_for_zh: 金朝名将，即金兀术，多次南侵。

people.name: Wu Jie
people.known_for: Defended Sichuan from the Jin with victories at Heshangyuan and Xianrenguan.
people.known_for_zh: 坚守川陕，和尚原、仙人关大败金军。

people.name: Zong Ze
people.known_for: Held Kaifeng against the Jin in 1127–1128 and urged the court to return north.
people.known_for_zh: 东京留守，坚守开封，临终三呼“过河”。

people.name: Li Tang
people.known_for: Landscape painter who bridged Northern and Southern Song styles and revived the court academy in Lin'an.
people.known_for_zh: 南宋四家之首，承前启后的山水画家。

works.title: Wind in Pines Among a Myriad Valleys

capitals.name: Bianjing (Kaifeng)
capitals.note: Taken by the Jurchen Jin in 1127.
